messages.subject: help setting a F34 AIL
parts:
Dear Karl,
I am trying to set our data from a F34 ail, where our individuals are full-sibs inside each family. I was able to get qtl2 to read my data but, when I calculated the kinship matrix I got an off-diag average of ~0.5, in contrast with other packages and softwares, also not possible given our breeding. So, I guess I am doing something wrong when trying to read/analyze the data.

I think that my mistake could probably come from the cross file, which I am not sure how to set up. Every other file I set up as needed in the manual pages.

I added screenshots from my yaml, cross and my commands to run qtls2 in case it helps

Thank you for your attention

Fernando

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: help setting a F34 AIL
parts:
The kinship coefficient of 0.5 sounds right to me.

The kinship coefficient is: consider an autosomal locus, and select a random allele from one individual and a random allele from the other individual, what is the chance the two alleles are identical by descent?
In any generation F_k, assuming no segregation distortion and large population size, you'd have equal frequencies of alleles A and B, and so the kinship coefficient should be 1/2.

Along the diagonal, for the kinship coefficient of an individual and itself, you should have 3/4 in this case.

karl
